posts.quote: I STARTED A LOAD OF LAUNDRY AT NOON. IT'S SIX NOW, AND I'M ABOUT TO WASH IT FOR THE SECOND TIME. THE WASHER HAS STOPPED JUDGING ME.
posts.alt: Cartoon illustration of a woman with a messy grey-streaked bun with a pencil in it, reading glasses on her forehead, an olive vest and striped shirt, standing in a laundry room holding a damp sweatshirt and a detergent jug beside an open washer, with a laundry basket at her feet and a clock showing six. Text at the top reads: I started a load of laundry at noon. It's six now, and I'm about to wash it for the second time. The washer has stopped judging me.

posts.quote: My car says it's 29 degrees out. My knees announced it at six this morning, and they didn't need a dashboard.
posts.alt: Plain off-white quote card with centered bold dark text. Text reads: My car says it's 29 degrees out. My knees announced it at six this morning, and they didn't need a dashboard.

posts.quote: I SET THREE TIMERS FOR THE PIES. TWO WENT OFF AT THE SAME TIME, AND THE THIRD IS SOMEWHERE I'LL FIND IT AT CHRISTMAS.
posts.alt: Cartoon illustration of a woman with a messy grey-streaked bun with a pencil in it and reading glasses on her head, flour on her olive vest, holding a beeping phone and a wooden spoon in a kitchen with two pies cooling, a timer ringing on the stove and a glass of red wine nearby. Text at the top reads: I set three timers for the pies. Two went off at the same time, and the third is somewhere I'll find it at Christmas.

posts.quote: I'm a size 10 at one store and a 14 at the next. The third one just stared at me.
posts.alt: Plain off-white quote card with centered bold dark text. Text reads: I'm a size 10 at one store and a 14 at the next. The third one just stared at me.

posts.quote: I PUT THE PORCH LIGHT ON AT 4:45 AND MY SLIPPERS ON AT 4:46. THE REST OF THE DAY CAN FIGURE ITSELF OUT.
posts.alt: Cartoon illustration of a woman with short mauve-pink curls, a mustard fairisle sweater and pink slippers, reclined in a floral armchair under a plaid blanket with a glass of red wine, a lamp glowing beside her and a dusky evening with a lit porch light outside the window. Text at the top reads: I put the porch light on at 4:45 and my slippers on at 4:46. The rest of the day can figure itself out.

posts.quote: My son showed me how to do it on the phone for the fourth time. He sighed exactly the way I did when I taught him to tie his shoes.
posts.alt: Plain off-white quote card with centered bold dark text. Text reads: My son showed me how to do it on the phone for the fourth time. He sighed exactly the way I did when I taught him to tie his shoes.

posts.quote: IF YOUR WHOLE PERSONALITY IS 'I'M JUST BEING HONEST,' I'D LIKE YOU TO HONESTLY GO SIT SOMEWHERE ELSE.
posts.alt: Cartoon illustration of a woman with a huge halo of auburn curls, round glasses, red lipstick, gold hoop earrings and a bold geometric tunic, side-eyeing with one palm raised in a stop gesture and a wine glass in the other hand in a living room. Text at the top reads: If your whole personality is "I'm just being honest," I'd like you to honestly go sit somewhere else.

stories.quote: I'VE BEEN COOKING FOR THREE DAYS. THE FAMILY WILL EAT IT IN TWENTY MINUTES. I'VE MADE PEACE WITH THE MATH.
stories.alt: Cartoon illustration of a barefoot woman with silver-white wavy hair and lavender round glasses in a cardigan and joggers, sitting calmly at a kitchen table with a mug of tea, surrounded by casserole dishes, a roasting pan with a turkey and three pies. Text at the top reads: I've been cooking for three days. The family will eat it in twenty minutes. I've made peace with the math.
